executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-18 reviewed eight relevant items; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will only reach the market with a time lag. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
